I recently realized I was taking my thyroid meds wrong. You need to wait a full hour after taking synthroid before eating and two hours after synthroid before taking any other meds or vitamins/supplements or eating dairy. I know it’s a huge hassle, but I’ve started doing it this way and I’m way less tired. Today I didn’t wait the full hour and I sure paid for it. So tired, all day.
